verdict.rationale: PCI scope reduction is a fair question for an in-person payments terminal product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions PCI compliance, end-to-end encryption, certified readers, or guidance on a merchant's remaining compliance obligations. The available items cover readers, Tap to Pay, offline mode, tipping, and receipts, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations
